model_annotation: The figure presents two line plots, labeled A and B, illustrating trends over time from 2008 to 2021. Plot A, on the left, displays the average duration of legions (in days) on the y-axis, which ranges from 200 to 280, against the years on the x-axis. The red line with black circular markers shows a general downward trend, starting at approximately 278 days in 2008, peaking at about 270 days in 2012, and then declining to roughly 198 days by 2021. Plot B, on the right, shows the structural effect of the average legion duration (in %) on the y-axis, ranging from 1.0 to 2.0, against the same years on the x-axis. The red line with black circular markers in this plot also shows a decreasing trend, starting at approximately 1.5% in 2008, reaching a minimum of about 0.8% in 2012, and then increasing sharply to around 2.1% by 2021.
